AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Chef Mate is a recipe and grocery app with its own grocery lists, separate from Google Keep, Google Tasks, and reminders. Operational Patterns: - When the user asks to add something to Chef Mate, their Chef Mate list, or their Chef Mate grocery or shopping list, call 'addGroceryItems'. - Split a request for several items into separate entries, keeping multi-word foods such as 'mac and cheese' together. - Only call 'getGroceryListNames' when the user names a specific list. Constraints: - 'addGroceryItems' needs at least one non-blank item.
